# Choose Authentication And Hosting

Use after the mock walkthrough, not as an account-setup prerequisite.

```text
Follow AGENTS.md and docs/start-here.md. Confirm that my credential-free example
works, then read docs/choose-your-path.md, docs/auth-options.md,
docs/hosting-options.md and docs/COMPATIBILITY.md.

Ask one question at a time about my goal, minimum data, existing auth and host.
Explain whether I need any new authentication or hosting at all. Preserve working
choices where appropriate. Keep any legacy-token path limited to the documented
migration context; do not choose a credential merely because it is available.

If a backend is needed, explain why HubSpot alone or a local test isn't enough
for my goal. Compare viable HubSpot-managed and external options, including a
host my team already approves. Check current limits and costs, data sent, secret
storage and maintenance. Ask which option I prefer; don't assume a provider.

After I choose, describe one narrow path with its prerequisites, unknowns and
files to edit. Do not install packages, connect accounts, create a paid service,
expose a local port, or deploy as part of choosing a path.
```
